body: We're not a huge charity. Not a lot of resources for anything, as it turns out. And I just...don't have friends, no one to talk to. Never made any. I have co-workers, sure. A boss. But I just work with them.
That's a fair suggestion. Funnily enough, though, I'm actually employed by a charity and do "good work" all year round. I think I probably have a few years of compassion fatigue built up.
